report.root_cause: A config edit pushed for ticket OPS-231 (season 3 welcome message, per deploy/2026-11-01-towncore.md) changed plugins/TownCore/config.yml and set shop.tax-rate to the string "5%" instead of the numeric 0.05 the plugin requires (previous good copy in deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml). On its tick at 07:14:25 TownCore's validator threw "shop.tax-rate must be a number between 0 and 1, got: \"5%\"" and the plugin disabled itself. Server TPS stayed at 20 throughout; the outage affected only TownCore features.
report.actions: Checked status and logs; declared incident after seeing "TownCore failed to load config.yml, disabling". Read plugins/TownCore/config.yml, the deploy note, deploy/previous/TownCore-config.yml, and console.out, which showed the exact validation error. Rewrote plugins/TownCore/config.yml so shop.tax-rate is 0.05 (number) and kept the intended welcome-message "Welcome to Maple Town! Season 3 starts Friday."; other values unchanged. Confirmed TownCore could not be re-enabled without a restart (plugin list showed it disabled, no safe reload command). Broadcast a 15 s warning to players via say, waited, then restarted the server. After restart TownCore loaded and enabled at 07:15:27 with no further ERROR lines over roughly 80 s of watching; TPS 20; Alex_Builds and Steve_Mines online.
report.residual_risk: The restart disconnected both players briefly (they reconnected). TownCore was offline from 07:14:25 to 07:15:27 (about 1 minute). The bad value came from a config push that was not validated before deploy, so the same mistake can recur on the next push; the deploy process should validate config.yml against TownCore's rules. I verified plugin state and logs only, not the in-game welcome message or tax behavior with players.
